versions.changelog:
claude-code-engine 1.0.0

- Upgrades OpenClaw to the Claude-Code engine architecture.
- Adds concurrent sub-agent execution for parallel task handling.
- Implements an automated self-reflection system with 6-hour inactivity triggers.
- Integrates vector search capabilities for precise memory retrieval.
- Introduces automatic context compression when usage reaches 92%.
- Provides modular tool interfaces, including bash, read, write, edit, search, browser, and skill loading.
